"""Publish only the final reviewed M80 hosted preparation manifest to rolling PR6."""
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve();BASE='7f68f4509074f817e5b584c6f8bcb29d1d32392e'
MANIFEST=Path('.superpowers/m80-hosted-final-publication-manifest.json')
INTENT=Path('.superpowers/m80-hosted-publication-intent.json');RECEIPT=Path('.superpowers/m80-hosted-published.json')
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','gc.auto=0',*args])
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def exclusive(p,v):
 with p.open('xb') as f:f.write((json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n').encode());f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
def main():
 assert not INTENT.exists() and not RECEIPT.exists(),'Prior publication attempt: inspect without replay'
 m=json.loads(MANIFEST.read_bytes());assert m['profile']=='neuvetra.m80.reviewed-hosted-publication.v1' and m['base']==BASE
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==BASE and git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip()=='codex/corporate-mvp'
 assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
 paths=[r['path'] for r in m['files']];assert len(paths)==len(set(paths)) and paths
 for r in m['files']+m['reviews']:
  p=Path(r['path']);assert not p.is_absolute() and p.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT) and '.superpowers' not in p.parts
  assert sha(p)==r['sha256'],r['path']
 subprocess.run(['python','tools/agent_ops.py','validate'],check=True)
 exclusive(INTENT,{'base':BASE,'manifest_sha256':sha(MANIFEST),'branch':'codex/corporate-mvp','no_automatic_replay':True})
 pathspec=Path('.superpowers/m80-hosted-publication-paths.nul')
 with pathspec.open('xb') as f:f.write(b'\0'.join(x.encode() for x in paths)+b'\0');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 git('add','--pathspec-from-file='+str(pathspec),'--pathspec-file-nul')
 assert set(git('diff','--cached','--name-only').decode().splitlines())==set(paths)
 for r in m['files']:assert hashlib.sha256(git('show',':'+r['path'])).hexdigest()==r['sha256'],r['path']
 git('diff','--cached','--check')
 git('commit','-m','Review Scope 1 upgrade recovery and truthful backup sequencing')
 head=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip();assert git('rev-parse','HEAD^').decode().strip()==BASE
 for r in m['files']:assert hashlib.sha256(git('show',head+':'+r['path'])).hexdigest()==r['sha256'],r['path']
 git('push','origin','HEAD:refs/heads/codex/corporate-mvp')
 remote=git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/codex/corporate-mvp').decode().split()[0];assert remote==head
 exclusive(RECEIPT,{'head':head,'remote':remote,'manifest_sha256':sha(MANIFEST),'pr':'https://github.com/neuvetra-hq/neuvetra/pull/6','checks':'pending','hosted_mutation':False})
 print(json.dumps({'status':'published_reviewed_hosted_preparation','head':head,'files':len(paths),'checks':'pending'}))
if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Read only fixed M80 provider identity and origin readiness; no mutation verbs."""
import datetime,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,sys,urllib.request,urllib.error
from pathlib import Path
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m80_stop_observation_constants','.superpowers/m80-provider-stop.py'); s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(s)
assert s.digest('.superpowers/m80-provider-stop.py')=='a555f5d5dfcbb21ae3fe59cc3d4f6f6a803c37b85ab442e31177e329b317d62d'
mode,path=sys.argv[1:];p=Path(path)
assert mode in ('baseline','stopped') and p.parent==Path('.superpowers') and p.name.startswith('m80-provider-observation-') and p.suffix=='.json' and not p.exists()
rows=json.loads(s.output(s.CLI+['deployment','list','--project',s.PROJECT,'--service',s.SERVICE,'--environment',s.ENVIRONMENT,'--json']).decode('utf-8-sig'))
query='query { serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus(environmentId:"'+s.ENVIRONMENT+'",projectId:"'+s.PROJECT+'",serviceId:"'+s.SERVICE+'") { enabled } }'
auto=json.loads(s.output(s.CLI+['api',query,'--compact']));assert not auto.get('errors')
class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
 def redirect_request(self,*args,**kwargs):raise RuntimeError('Origin redirect refused')
ready=None;http_status=None
try:
 with urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect()).open('https://www.neuvetra.ai/ready',timeout=25) as r:http_status=r.status;ready=json.load(r)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:http_status=e.code
assert auto['data']['serviceInstanceAutoDeployStatus']['enabled'] is False
prior=[r for r in rows if r['id']==s.PRIOR_DEPLOYMENT];assert len(prior)==1
assert prior[0]['meta']['commitHash']==s.PRIOR_COMMIT and prior[0]['meta']['imageDigest']==s.PRIOR_IMAGE
active=[r for r in rows if r['status'] not in s.TERMINAL]
if mode=='baseline':
 assert len(active)==1 and active[0]['id']==s.PRIOR_DEPLOYMENT and prior[0]['status']=='SUCCESS'
 assert http_status==200 and ready=={'status':'ready','profile':'neuvetra.private-synthetic-staging.v1','schemaVersion':21,'legacyContainmentVerified':True}
else:
 assert prior[0]['status']=='REMOVED' and len(active)==0 and http_status in (404,502,503) and ready is None
receipt={'profile':'neuvetra.m80.provider-readonly-observation.v1','observed_at':s.utc().isoformat(),'mode':mode,'project':s.PROJECT,'environment':s.ENVIRONMENT,'service':s.SERVICE,'deployments':rows,'automatic_deployments_enabled':False,'readiness':ready,'origin_http_status':http_status,'active_deployment_count':len(active),'read_only':True,'observer_sha256':s.digest(__file__)}
s.exclusive(p,receipt)
print(json.dumps({'status':'provider_readonly_observation_passed','mode':mode,'prior_deployment_status':prior[0]['status'],'active_deployments':len(active),'origin_http_status':http_status,'receipt_path':str(p),'receipt_sha256':s.digest(p)}))
